newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Malaysian king on state visit to Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian king on state visit to Cambodia.

text.p: Malaysia's King Tuanku Ja'afar on Monday began a state visit to Cambodia, the first by a foreign monarch to the Southeast Asian nation in more than a quarter century.

King Norodom Sihanouk and top government officials, including co-Premiers Prince Norodom Ranariddh and Hun Sen, greeted the Malaysian king and his entourage as they arrived at Phnom Penh's Pochentong Airport aboard a special flight.
The welcoming party included representatives of the ethnic Cham community, who practise Islam.
King Ja'afar, who is returning a 1995 visit by Sihanouk to Malaysia, held talks with Sihanouk at the royal palace and was to meet the two premiers later in the day, officials said.

His schedule includes golf on Tuesday at a half-finished course outside Phnom Penh and a tour of the ancient Angkor temples in northwest Cambodia on Wednesday. The king and his wife leave for home on Thursday.
